title: The Surpassing Worth of Knowing Christ
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: Knowing and loving Jesus is our secret weapon against sin. He is our joy, our strength and our victory.
exhortation: Knowing and loving Jesus is the secret weapon in this world against sin and temptation.
Jesus is our joy. He's like the treasure in the field: a man found it and sold all he had to buy it. When we get a glimpse of Jesus, we see that his worth far surpasses anything else.

In Jesus we find our strength. Like a passionate hobby or a consuming goal in life, knowing and loving Jesus makes it easier and easier to say no to the things of this world, to sin and to other distractions.
And Jesus is our victory. He is both the goal and the path, the destination and the way there. All we need and all we want is found in Jesus.
prayer: Jesus, with you a spiritually full life is possible. We could fill our lives with other pursuits: a career, money, even a good family. These things may not be bad in themselves, but without you our lives will have no eternal purpose.

We want to live for your glory, in your kingdom. We want to live in your victory and in the goodness you have purchased for us. So may we live as sons and daughters of the King this morning. In Jesus' name, amen.
